proposal.summary: Insecure direct object reference (IDOR) in GET /api/v2/orders/{id} allows viewing other customers' orders including addresses by changing the id.
proposal.cwe_quote: IDOR on /api/v2/orders/{id} - changing the id shows other customers' orders including addresses.
